preconditions: Two ordered map coordinates define A and B
requiredEvidence: DEM profile for optional terrain descriptors
decisionLogic: Preserve A/B order and exact endpoints in acquisition, model, export contract and drawing
Display all available administrative levels; never replace them by a nearby representative point
When detailed place name is absent, append a supported local landform descriptor from the existing terrain classifier
Use only EvidenceSupported or ShapeSupported results; mark DEM-derived labels as inferred descriptors, not official place names
Preserve partial administrative information on lookup failure; never infer mountainous terrain from address absence
Keep map downloads outside the UI event loop; at most four in-flight requests and 128 cached tiles
outputs: Exact endpoint annotation text in Model Space
uncertainty: Map click and reverse-geocoded names are not survey positions. Service availability and municipality coverage are not guaranteed.

sources.title: GSI Maps reverse-geocoding service
sources.adoptionReason: Live official response verified; coordinates retained

sources.title: GSI Maps municipality code table
sources.adoptionReason: Decode official municipality codes into prefecture and municipality; table hash retained

implementationChoices.geometry: Existing EARTH_RADIUS_M=6378137 spherical route convention, not survey geodesy
implementationChoices.terrainContext: Within 500 m of each endpoint; minimum three profile samples

validationMethod: Exact endpoint equality; missing/coincident/out-of-scope rejection; partial and conflicting address fixtures; failed/slow network; native text persistence; print inspection
reopenCondition: Changed official response format, administrative table, route convention, landform classifier, GUI loader or native annotation layout
